prompt: Hand-drawn, clean, minimalist illustration of a surreal healing riverside landscape. A forest of ancient trees is composed almost entirely (90%) of an overwhelming abundance of tiny, intricate leaves, so dense that only hints of trunks and branches are visible. Each leaf is rendered with delicate contours and ultra-detailed veins, bathed in luminous, vividly saturated pastel bud-green tones that feel dreamlike and otherworldly, evoking the freshness of new spring growth. A calm river occupies 20% of the composition, reflecting soft, ethereal light, and a tiny figure (5-10%) walks or rides a bicycle near the trees.
